vehicle: ATLAS-01: roughly two-metre-long unmanned American aerospace-inspired Mars rover. Low rectangular warm-white equipment body, navy-blue inset side panels, flat charcoal deck. Six broad open-metal-mesh wheels, three per side, connect visibly to the chassis through dark articulated suspension and clear hubs. One short central mast carries a compact horizontal pair of camera lenses. One short two-joint sampling arm mounts at the FRONT centre of the chassis, ending in a small cylindrical contact tool; it folds against the front for travel. The rear is a plain sealed service panel. Matte ceramic-painted panels, brushed metal arm sections, dark protected pivots, a few recessed bolts. No loose cables, decorative fins or passenger compartment. Keep wheel, axle and suspension orientations mechanically coherent.

mission.name: First Light Survey
mission.purpose: Map a landing plain and inspect basalt exposures for later sampling routes.
mission.arrival: A robotic lander lowers a short ramp onto a broad stony plain.
